description: Harden the public LLM authoring, inspection, visual review, and evidence workflow

sprint.goal: Make the supported static asset workflow independently discoverable, safely editable, visually reviewable, and reproducible by a fresh MCP-capable LLM without source knowledge.
sprint.demo_notes: Phases S1 through S3 are owner-approved. The repository-local workflow skill now requires capability preflight, inspect/dry-run/compare discipline, exact unavailable-tool reporting, audit-only artifact checks, and three-surface visual review. S4 must still prove portable manifests, a fresh MCP-led execution, and representative external import or record it as not assessed.
